dct_creator_sm: Amundsen Science Core Data Collection DATA Coordinator : Tahiana Ratsimbazafy.
dct_description_sm: The purpose of this dataset is to serve as continuation of the previous AVOS (Automated Voluntary Observation Ship) after 2023. The AVOS system provided standard meteorological parameters. The actual ATS adds more, such as shortwave and long wave radiation fluxes
dct_title_s: ATmospheric System (ATS) data collected aboard the CCGS Amundsen in the Canadian Arctic.
